name: Bato Bato Pick
description: Real player-versus-player Rock Paper Scissors. Pick a move in secret, reveal together, and make the losing player take 1 HP damage.

questions.prompt: Bato, bato… pick! Choose your move.
questions.explanation: Moves are compared directly against the opponent's move.

questions.prompt: Choose in secret. What will you throw?
questions.explanation: Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, and Paper beats Rock.

questions.prompt: Read your opponent—or trust your luck. Pick now!
questions.explanation: Matching moves draw and replay without damage.
